guarantees.claim: When clr_txcount is asserted, txcount_d is driven to 0 regardless of other control signals.

When clr_txcount is deasserted and load_txcount is asserted, txcount_d is set to message_length_i plus a block-size constant: BlockSizeSHA256in64 for SHA2_256, BlockSizeSHA512in64 for SHA2_384 or SHA2_512, and 0 for any other digest_size_i.

When neither clr_txcount nor load_txcount is asserted and inc_txcount is asserted, txcount_d is assigned the value of txcount with bits [63:5] incremented by 1, effectively increasing the counter by 32 while preserving the five least-significant bits.
When clr_txcount, load_txcount, and inc_txcount are all deasserted, txcount_d is equal to txcount (hold).

assumptions.claim: When load_txcount is asserted, digest_size_i must be SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512; the default case adds zero block size, which would produce an incorrect total message length used in HMAC computation.
assumptions.risk: HMAC tag computed with wrong message length, potentially compromising integrity or security.

uncertain_points.claim: The default case for digest_size_i under load_txcount adds zero block size. If the HMAC module can operate with digest sizes other than SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512 (e.g., future SHA-2 variants or misconfiguration), the message length will lack the required inner-pad block size, leading to an incorrect HMAC result.
uncertain_points.cond: load_txcount == 1 and digest_size_i not in {SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512}
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect HMAC tag, potential security bypass.
